name: Phinehas
bio: This Phinehas was the son of the priest Eli, who served as a priest at Shiloh alongside his brother Hophni — sharing his name, but not his character, with the earlier Phinehas, Aaron's grandson, who had been granted a covenant of peace for his zealous act against sin at Baal Peor. This Phinehas, by contrast, acted wickedly and did not know the LORD. He and his brother seized for themselves portions of the offerings that belonged to God and slept with women who gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting, causing the people to treat the LORD's offering with contempt (1 Samuel 2:12-17, 22). A man of God came and warned Eli that his two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, would die on the same day, as a sign of the LORD's judgment on Eli's entire house (1 Samuel 2:34). Israel later went to war against the Philistines at Aphek, and the people brought the ark into the camp hoping it would bring victory; Phinehas and Hophni went out with the ark, but Israel was defeated again, the ark was captured, and both brothers were killed that day, exactly as the man of God had prophesied (1 Samuel 4:1-11). Phinehas's wife was pregnant and near delivery; the shock of hearing that the ark was captured and that her father-in-law and husband were dead sent her into labor, and as she lay dying she named her newborn son Ichabod, meaning "no glory," lamenting the capture of the ark and the deaths of her husband and father-in-law (1 Samuel 4:19-22).
